summary: Iteration 8 - verified the same-origin WS URL derivation fix. /api/health returns ok (udp_port=4001, simulator=true). Frontend loads, WebSocket connects to wss://compass-display.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws/heading (matches window.location.host - same-origin confirmed). LED data-status=live, digital heading updates (277.7°), COG/SOG/ROT all populated, NMEA log feeding. Settings dialog opens and populates udp-port-value=4001 and simulator-mode-value=SIMULATOR via relative /api fetch. Zero console errors. grep confirms no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL usages remain in /app/frontend/src.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: an extra websocket to wss://<host>/ws is opened (likely CRA dev-server sockjs/webpack-hmr artifact carried over). Harmless in production preview but worth confirming it's not from a stale service worker or dev-only code path.
frontend/.env still contains REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — safe now because nothing reads it, but consider removing to avoid future footguns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same-origin WS fix verified in cloud preview. Offline-LAN scenario itself can only be validated on-site by the user. WS URL observed: wss://compass-display.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws/heading (matches window.location.host).
